name: Citizenship by Marriage (Form I)

qualifying_event.description: The female spouse of a Bahamian citizen may apply for registration as a citizen using Form I.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; spouse's proof of Bahamian citizenship.

requirements.blocker_text: This route (Form I) is available only to the FEMALE spouse of a Bahamian citizen -- male spouses of female Bahamian citizens are not eligible for citizenship registration by marriage under this form.
Requires medical and police certificates alongside the marriage certificate and spouse's documentation.

evidence_required.document: Two character references from a Bahamian knowing the applicant 5+ years

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department -- Pathways to Bahamian Citizenship: Form I, spousal route restricted to the female spouse of a Bahamian citizen, requiring marriage certificate, spouse's documentation, medical and police certificates

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Bahamas' initial build. IMPORTANT: this route is explicitly gender-restricted on the official government source -- only the FEMALE spouse of a Bahamian citizen may apply for citizenship by marriage via Form I. No equivalent Form was found on this source for a male spouse of a female Bahamian citizen; such a person appears to be limited to the residence-based routes (bs_resident_spouse_permit.json, then bs_permanent_residence_marriage.json, then bs_naturalisation.json after accumulating the required PR duration) rather than a direct marriage-based citizenship registration. This is a real, sourced restriction (part of the same gender-asymmetric nationality-law pattern flagged in bs_citizenship_by_descent.json's notes, long subject to constitutional-reform debate in the Bahamas), not an oversight in this build -- disclosed prominently since it changes the practical answer depending on the applicant's and spouse's sex. No marriage-duration figure was found for this specific route (unlike the Resident Spouse Permit's 5-year threshold); may require a shorter or different timeline than the residence-based routes.
